Name: SynthKitten's Geode Animation Skip
Author: SynthKittenDev
Description:
Ever open up 100 Geodes and realize just how long it takes? No more! Speed up the geode opening animation or skip it entirely!

You can configure the speed of the animation or to skip it entirely in the configuration file.
